app.name: Digital Madrasa
app.tagline: Barashada Quranka, xaadirinta iyo lacagta — madrasada oo dhan.

auth.welcomeTitle: Baro, bar oo maamul madrasadaada meel keliya
auth.welcomeBody: La soco xifdiga, qaad xaadirinta, qiimee tajwiidka oo ururi lacagta — waxaa loo sameeyay madrasadaha Kenya iyo Bariga Afrika.
auth.parentAccountHint: La soco horumarka ilmahaaga oo bixi lacagta
auth.signInBody: Gal si aad u sii wadato meeshii aad ka tagtay.
auth.resetSent: Haddii emaylkaas la diiwaan geliyay, koodh ayaa soo socda.
auth.enterCodeBody: Waxaan u dirnay koodh 6 god ah {{email}}. Wuxuu dhacayaa 30 daqiiqo gudahood.
auth.demoCodeNotice: Nuqul tijaabo ah: emayl lama dirin. Koodhkaagu waa {{code}}.
auth.newPasswordBody: Dooro mid aadan hore ugu isticmaalin akoonkan.
auth.passwordHint: Ugu yaraan 10 xaraf, oo leh nambar iyo xaraf weyn.
auth.passwordUpdatedBody: Waa lagaa saaray dhammaan qalabka. Ku gal furahaaga cusub.
auth.countyHint: Wuxuu furayaa liis la baari karo oo ah dhammaan 47-ka gobol
auth.countyNoMatch: Ma jiro gobol u dhigma raadintaas.
auth.acceptDataPolicy: Waan oggolaaday in Digital Madrasa ay xogtan u isticmaasho sida Sharciga Ilaalinta Xogta Kenya 2019
auth.registerParentBody: Ka dib diiwaangelinta, ku dar ilmahaaga adigoo isticmaalaya lambarka diiwaangelinta.
auth.confirmEmailBody: Waxaan u dirnay xiriir xaqiijin {{email}}. Fur si aad u shidid madrasadaada.
auth.confirmEmailNote: Madrasadaada waa la sameeyay. Waxaad u baahan tahay oo kaliya inaad xaqiijiso ciwaanka.

validation.phone_invalid: Geli lambar Kenyaan ah oo sax ah
validation.admission_no_invalid: Lambarka diiwaangelintu wuxuu u eg yahay DM-2026-0042

errors.genericBody: Ma aan dhammaystiri karin. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
errors.networkBody: Ma gaari karin server-ka, markaa isbeddelkaas lama kaydin. Fiiri xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.
errors.invalidCredentials: Iimaylka ama furuhu sax ma aha.
errors.madrasaSuspended: Madrasadan waa la joojiyay. La xiriir maamulaha.

empty.noChildrenBody: Geli lambarka diiwaangelinta ee madrasadu ku siisay, waxaanan codsi u dirayaa macallinkiisa.

student.aiDisclaimer: Talada AI waxay caawisaa tababarka; qiimaynta macallinkaagu waa tan kama dambaysta ah.

live.cannotOpenBody: Ku rakib abkaa shirka ama xiriirka ka fur biraawsarka, ka dibna isku day mar kale.
live.unsupportedLink: Xiriirkan kama imanayo bixiye la aqbalay.
live.manageBody: Ku dheji xiriir Google Meet, Teams ama Zoom. Ardaydu waxay arki doonaan badhanka ku biiritaanka 15 daqiiqo ka hor casharka.

billing.mpesaHint: Ka bixi taleefankaaga adoo isticmaalaya STK
billing.securityNote: Xogta kaarkaagu waa la sireeyay oo si toos ah loo diray bixiyaha lacag bixinta. Weligeen ma kaydinno lambarka kaarkaaga.
billing.trialBody: Kadib waa {{price}} bishii si aad u sii diiwaan geliso arday oo aad lacag u ururiso.
billing.pastDueTitle: Lacag bixin ayaa loo baahan yahay
billing.pastDueBody: Tijaabadu way dhammaatay. Bixi {{price}} si aad u sii wadato.
billing.graceBody: Weli waxaad madrasada u maamuli kartaa dhowr maalmood. Hadda bixi si aadan u joogsan.
billing.restrictedTitle: Diiwaangelinta iyo qaansheegashada waa la joojiyay
billing.restrictedBody: Ardaydu way sii baranayaan, waxbana lama tirtirin. Bixi si aad dib ugu bilowdo diiwaangelinta iyo qaansheegashada.
billing.cancelledBody: Wakhti kasta dib u bilow. Xogtaadu waa sida ay ahayd.
billing.graceEnds: Qalabka maamulku wuxuu xirmayaa {{date}}, {{count}} maalmood kadib lacag bixinta la seegay.
billing.learningNeverBlocked: Ardaydu weligood ma lumiyaan casharradooda, akhriskooda ama horumarkooda — wax kasta oo lacagta ku dhacaba.
billing.oneMonthOfAccess: Hal bil oo helitaan buuxa ah madrasadaada oo dhan.
billing.stkSent: Geli PIN-kaaga M-Pesa si aad u ansixiso {{price}}.
billing.cardProcessing: Tani waxay qaadanaysaa dhowr ilbiriqsi. Ha xirin abka.
billing.paymentSuccessBody: Madrasadaadu waa la bixiyay bisha soo socota. Mahadsanid.
billing.paymentFailedBody: Lacag bixintu ma dhicin. Lacag kama bixin akoonkaaga.
billing.noPayments: Weli lacag bixin ma jirto. Lacagtaada koowaad waxay dhacaysaa marka tijaabadu dhammaato.
billing.autoRenew: Si toos ah ayuu u cusboonaanayaa
billing.ownerOnly: Kaliya milkiilaha madrasada ayaa beddeli kara rukunka.

emptyBody.student: Weydii sida aad u horumarayso ama waxa aad celin lahayd.
emptyBody.teacher: Weydii waxqabadka fasalka ama ardayda u baahan caawimaad.
emptyBody.parent: Weydii sida ilmahaagu u socdo, ama waxa caawin lahaa.

ai.clearBody: Fariimaha waa la saarayaa. Waxba lagama kaydiyo qalabkaaga.
ai.chooseChildBody: Marka hore dooro ilmaha aad wax ka weydiinayso.
ai.disclaimer: Talada AI way caawisaa waxbarashada; qiimaynta macallinkaagu waa tan kama dambaysta ah.
